headline: Build trust first. Keep your project continuity.
summary: BOS offers a self-service account trial after verified sign-in and acceptance of current terms. Your first verified project starts one calendar month shared across all projects, with one account expiry and the highest delivered customer tier allowed by current security and access checks. Installed stabilisation and saved records remain afterwards. After the trial expires, already-started trial workflows may finish within seven days; this starts no new workflows. Other access follows its own verified expiry or revocation. Fresh cloud help needs active access. Check My BOS for authoritative dates and access; no automatic charge.

plans.name: Self-service account trial
plans.description: After verified sign-in and acceptance of current terms, your first verified project starts one calendar month of active cloud help. All projects share one account expiry. The trial provides the highest delivered customer tier within current security, capability and project checks. Reinstallation or another project does not restart the trial. Installed stabilisation and saved records remain; no automatic charge.

plans.name: Generous start
plans.description: Experience useful help across several sessions, including returning to your project. The exact allowance will be published before launch.

plans.name: Stabilisation stays
plans.description: After the trial expires, already-started trial workflows may finish within seven days; this starts no new workflows. Other access follows its own verified expiry or revocation. Without other valid access, fresh cloud help stops after that trial window. Installed build rules, existing checks, decisions and project memory remain. Passes and subscriptions remain planned, not live. Cloud retention terms will be published.

plans.name: Standard pass
plans.description: A$15 for seven consecutive days from activation. A one-off purchase with no automatic renewal. The usage allowance and activation terms will be published before sales begin.

plans.name: Standard subscription
plans.description: A$29 per month for regular builders. Renews only with your consent; cancellation stops future renewal. Included usage and full terms will be published before sales begin.

transition.notice: BOS stabilisation stays with your app. After the trial expires, already-started trial workflows may finish within seven days; this starts no new workflows. Other access follows its own verified expiry or revocation. Without other valid access, fresh cloud help stops after that trial window. Installed rules, checks and saved records remain. No automatic paid conversion.

support.included: Self-service guidance and a structured channel for plugin-defect reports.

access_boundary: This public programme describes the offer, not your account entitlement. Current authenticated server capability and project checks remain authoritative. Existing account commitments are preserved; a new installation does not create a new free allowance.
external_costs: Development-platform subscriptions, hosting, AI usage and credits are separate. Any applicable taxes and payment charges will be disclosed before purchase.

provisional_test_limits.unit: one agreed review or change plan with bounded follow-up; not individual messages

wire_compatibility.LIGHT_period: Legacy wire identifier only; the description and transition describe the seven-day window for already-started trial workflows, then stabilisation only without other valid access. Other access follows its own verified expiry or revocation.
